help.goal: Villagers hunt the hidden wolves, wolves eat the village. You win when your side is the only one left.
steps: Read your secret role on your phone, then tap Ready 🌙.
At night wolves tap a victim and the seer taps someone to inspect.
Everyone else waits out the night with eyes closed.
By day, argue out loud about who is acting suspicious.
When the clock runs out, tap a face to vote, or Skip.
notes: This is a talking game; the phone only keeps your role secret.
The table screen narrates night and day and runs the discussion clock.
A strict majority lynches, anything less and nobody dies.
